regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler leads with 34" over the window, peaking at 17" on Friday. Expect rain through most of the week, with a Special Weather Statement from Tuesday to Thursday night. Snow arrives mostly Friday.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain has 10" through Friday, with 7" on Friday alone, though most of that falls as rain and snow mixed. Stevens Pass totals 9", with 6" Friday. Mt. Baker has 4". Expect wet, gusty conditions most days.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Whiteface totals 7", peaking at 5" Friday, and Killington has 6" with 5" Friday. Friday brings light snow with northeast wind gusting to 23 mph. Blue Mountain in Ontario has 6", with 4" on Thursday.

ahead.text: The Weather Prediction Center says an organized storm may reach the West Coast around Saturday Nov 14 into Sunday Nov 15, with heavier rain and high mountain snow. Its confidence is moderate, given the uncertainty in the storm's track.
